Proof in the paper: The characteristic peak with 2θ at 34.3° matches well with (012) plane of the typical hydrotalcite-like structure, suggested LDHs structure of the species on α-Fe2O3. No other impurity peak was observed, indicating LDHs were of pure phases and the deposition of LDHs did not change the crystalline structure of α-Fe2O3. (Fig. 1a)
